mission.title: Unbearable Burden
mission.description: Hunt down Captain Rat and the crew of the Bacchus.

npc.say: The letter is in his bedroom. You may take it.
I -- I can't stay here.... must.... leave.

phase.briefing:
I have an interesting job for you, {player}. A Zion Operative known as Captain Rat of the Bacchus has taken it upon himself to become... an unbearable burden in the search for Morpheus. We require that his life, and those aboard his crew, are put to an indefinite end.
Rat and his crew were last seen at this location. Go there, locate Rat and his crew and present them the gift of... death. You will succeed, won't you? Yes, of course you will.

enter.say: Search the place for Rat and the crew of the Bacchus. When you find them, kill every last one.

done.say: Rat isn't even here! This is going to make the assignment that much more difficult... Hmm, wait... Gnu was one of Rat's men aboard the Bacchus. We may be able to salvage something out of this, search Gnu's corpse!
I think you just pissed off the security crew. Take them out!
Maybe that'll teach them that anger never solves anything.

The document that you found is a plan written out by none other than the Zion Operative that we need to assassinate, Captain Rat. Let me do a scan of the file, and by the time you are out of the building, Flood should have an update for you.

phase.briefing: Okay, here's the score, {player}. Rat and Gnu were in the middle of a job to recruit a large number of redpill candidates from the Matrix and the document that you found lists the address of three bluepills. I can only assume that Denis Jurney was the second as the first name on the list has been crossed off. The last bluepill on the list is Salid Helmet, who lives very close to your current location. I've already sent you the address of Salid Helmet's apartment, head there now.

enter.say: This is Salid Helmet's apartment complex. Search his apartment and look for Captain Rat and the rest of the crew of the Bacchus. If you find them, put an end to their miserable lives.

talk.say: Are you looking for Salid Helmet? He just left with some of his strange friends. I can tell you where he went if you still want to talk to him. He left a note in his room with all of the details.
The letter is in his bedroom. You may take it.

objective.text: Find the letter in Salid Helmet's bedroom

done.say: We're getting somewhere now. The letter has the address of one of the many Zion Redpill Extraction Points. Leave and Flood will update you with the address.

complete.say: Uh, I don't feel good at all... Oh, gaah!

phase.briefing: I'm sending you the address of Rat's current location. Go there quickly, before they move again!

talk.say: The flies... flies everywhere! Flies in his eyes... flies in his brain... flies everywhere!
They're all dead! Someone killed the entire crew of the Bacchus! Well, except for Salid Helmet here...
I -- I can't stay here.... must.... leave.

mission.finish: This is quite odd. Each and every one of the bodies has a single, solitary bullet right in the middle of their head. Whoever murdered these Zion Operatives had precision aim. I've never heard of anyone who could shoot like that. I'm going to put in a few more leads. We may have a use for someone with such skills.
